critical_code_review_comments: req_batch_3.refund_audit_csv/pdf call refund_audit(...) with `_={}` positional bypass — works today but couples the two functions; consider extracting a private `_audit_query()` helper that does not depend on the FastAPI Depends parameter so the exports don't fake-inject the auth dep.

req_batch_3.bulk_mark_paid catches ImportError silently and falls back to a direct insert that does NOT respect existing paid_amount / partial-payout logic in crm_pay._record_payout — the fallback overwrites artist_payout_status to 'paid' regardless of overpayment; safer to fail the row if _record_payout is unavailable rather than double-book.

req_batch_3.build_email_timeline_html uses first-occurrence dedupe (`if k not in ev_by_kind`) which relies on sort('at',1) in fetch_booking_events — fine, but there is no fallback icon/label if the events collection stores a kind not in the `order` list (it will silently drop them). Consider appending unknown kinds under an 'Other' section for auditability.

req_batch_3.pending_payouts iterates the full cursor without an early Mongo-side filter for outstanding>0 — for large tenancies this can be slow. Add a $expr filter or compute artist_payable during query.
